verdict.rationale: vLLM is an LLM inference and serving engine. Setting up user-level autonomous background automations is a workflow or agent-platform capability, not something products of this kind ship. The evidence's 'scheduling' refers to GPU request batching, and tool calling is an API parsing feature, so neither makes this axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
